messages:
Maria L: heads-up — NZ marketplace launch tomorrow, we saw a driver regression on the new image when running GKA-40 instances. stack trace in canary logs.
Lee T: which driver and kernel? can you paste the failing line?
Maria L: reproducer shows nvidia 535.86 + linux 5.15. app fails during cudaInit with `cuInit: unresolved symbol` — looks like ABI mismatch.
Samir P: that's the same symptom we saw in staging with the new distro kernel. likely the kernel module wasn't rebuilt for that distro's kernel variant.
Olga R: on-marketplace images are built with our container-runtime kernel headers shim; for NZ partner images we used the partner's base which had a custom kernel. solution: pin the driver package or ship a kernel-module-compatible bundle.
Maria L: need a short plan: 1) pin marketplace listing to driver 525.x, 2) open hotpatch for images with rebuilt modules, 3) coordinate with AetherCloud to replace marketplace image in NZ region if approved.
Lee T: agree. can we do a canary deploy to one AZ first?
deploy-bot: canary deploy scheduled for 2165002000 — will post status updates when started.
Samir P: semantic for manifest: add `driver_version: "525.*"` and `compatibility_notes: "kernel 5.15 variants ok"`. I can PR the manifest now.
Olga R: also add a fallback route in console: requests from NZ marketplace can route to dedicated nodes in AU if the marketplace image fails health checks.
Maria L: @AetherCloud, can you confirm you can replace the NZ AMI within 2 hours if we push the rebuild?
AetherCloud-bizbot: Received. Partner ops assigned: @ops_nz will standby. ETA 90–120m for image swap under partner SLA.
Lee T: great. Samir, please open an internal regression ticket with logs + kernel version and tag eng-runtime and partnerships.
Samir P: done — ticket #INF-9281 with reproducer and sample logs. link: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/INF-9281
Maria L: final runbook: (a) pin marketplace manifest to 525.x, (b) create hotpatch image with rebuilt kernel modules, (c) canary in single AZ, (d) partner AMI swap if canary passes, (e) rollback to previous listing if failures. I will draft the marketplace PR and ping legal for joint-announcement wording.
Lee T: add a note to console: temporary perf delta expected due to older driver. :warning:
Olga R: I'll own the hotpatch build and CI. Samir — coordinate kernel headers and CI. Maria — I'll join the partner call now.
Maria L: thanks all. I’ll update this thread as we progress. :thumbsup:
